about_pullquote: We started this business because we believed customers deserved honest pricing and trustworthy work.
about_para_1: C & P Property Improvements was founded to set a new standard in Southampton plumbing and maintenance. With nearly two decades of hands-on experience, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, finishing the job right, and treating your home with the respect it deserves. Our team combines skill with straightforward communication — you'll always know what the work costs before we start.
about_para_2: Homeowners and landlords across Southampton come back to us because we don't cut corners or oversell unnecessary work. Whether it's an emergency at midnight or a planned installation, we bring the same professionalism and care. Our guarantee backs every job, and our emergency line is always open.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at 11pm on a Saturday. Called C & P and they arrived by midnight. Fixed it properly, not a band-aid job. Really impressed with the speed and the fair quote. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: New boiler installation with full pipework. The lads were tidy, knew what they were doing, and finished on schedule. System runs beautifully and they explained the warranty properly. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: Rachel P.

reviews.text: Bathroom overhaul from start to finish. They coordinated everything and didn't leave until we were happy. Priced honestly, worked hard, and the finish is stunning. Will use them again without doubt.
